title: Traffic
subtitle: Global recording proxy · all HTTP traffic
sortHostCountDesc: Packet count is descending; click to switch to ascending
sortHostCountAsc: Packet count is ascending; click to switch to descending
selectTargetFirst: Select a target on the left or enter a host first
clearAllTitle: Delete all traffic and compact storage
searchPlaceholder: Search all (URL / method / type / status code…)
deleteAllBody: This will permanently delete all {count} traffic records (including raw request/response data), ignoring the current filters. This cannot be undone. Traffic evidence bound to findings is kept in a separate evidence store and is not affected.
deleteAllCompactHint: Storage is compacted afterwards to return the disk space held by the index to the system; traffic recording pauses briefly in the meantime.
deleteSelectedBody: This will permanently delete all traffic records for {count} target(s) ({hosts}), including raw request/response data. This cannot be undone.
deleteFilterBody: This will permanently delete all traffic records whose host contains {host} (including raw request/response data). This cannot be undone.
deleteTitleSelected: Delete all traffic for the {count} selected targets?
deleteTitleFilter: Delete all traffic for this target?
